O.outcome_detail: association with play duration, extra clicks, first-try-correct rate, and total wrong clicks

result.effect: Spearman |ρ| ≤ 0.38; strongest association engagement–extra clicks ρ = -0.38, p = 0.08

cells.quote: Spearman rank correlations between each sub -dimension and the gameplay metrics (duration, extra clicks, first-try-correct rate, total wrong clicks) were all small-to-moderate (|ρ| ≤ 0.38) and none reached the uncorrected p < 0.05 threshold. The strongest tendency was a moderate negative association between engagement and extra clicks (ρ = -0.38, p = 0.08), intuitive but far from confirmatory at this sample size.
cells.note: The study reports exploratory measured associations rather than a manipulated treatment comparison.
